title: VidMuse Official Style Record
description: Structural contract derived from the canonical six-field content standard. Artistic quality remains a human and generation-test decision.

name.description: User-readable English name for the verified anchor scope.

tags.description: Ordered prompt-safe visual fingerprint: modality, style family, signature differences, then optional texture or visible atmosphere.

description.description: English selection rationale covering visual identity, applicable project intent, and meaningful neighbor boundary when needed.

analysis.description: English medium-adaptive analysis of evidence-supported visual mechanisms, transfer, motion where available, and failure boundaries.

promptSample.description: Pure style shell. It may repeat the name or anchor in its first phrase, followed by coordinated transferable visual controls.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of the approved original preview image.
